sources.note: Main homepage. Describes TCC as full-featured EHR + practice management suite, 20+ years in development, serving multiple disciplines. Mentions Bridge partnership for patient engagement.

TCC features page. Lists EHR, e-prescribing, document management, health maintenance, integrated billing, scheduling, reporting, lab/pharmacy interfacing, HIE, mobile access, customizable templates, dictation/voice/handwriting recognition.

Capabilities page. Details rapid documentation, e-prescribing, risk factor analysis, document management, scheduling, HIPAA billing, SmartCoder claims scrubbing, PQRS, ICD-10, Meaningful Use, clinical quality measures dashboard, multi-facility connectivity, patient portal, 'nation's first EHR to electronically submit cancer data to a state registry'.

Interoperability page. Describes interfacing with clinics, hospitals, imaging centers, labs. Details Kentucky HIE (KHIE) integration using secure web services, HL7 messaging, CDA. Cancer registry reporting to Kentucky Cancer Registry.
Philosophy page. TCC described as 'extremely powerful, flexible, and sophisticated' — not a 'cookie-cutter EHR'. Requires significant training for full value.

About Us page. Founded 1999 by Dr. Dennis Ulrich (family practice). Provides EHR + practice management + billing services for solo practitioners, mid-sized clinics, hospital-based groups. Created CorrecTek in 2006 for correctional healthcare (jails, prisons, detention centers).

FAQ page. Mentions HIPAA compliance, encryption, multi-level security, 2-3 month implementation for small practices, 10-15 hours training per person (20 for financial staff), serves doctors, urgent care, therapists, NPs, PAs.

ONC mandatory disclosures. TCC 7.1 certified 2019-12-26. Lists costs for: software license, implementation/training, annual maintenance, NewCrop e-prescribing (add-on), Medfusion patient portal (add-on), Direct Messaging (add-on), Application Access API (add-on), Meaningful Use configuration. EHI export in PDF or C-CDA format.
CorrecTek website. Subsidiary/brand of UMC for correctional healthcare EHR. Offers 'Spark' product (ONC-certified). Limited content rendered from JavaScript-heavy page.
LeadIQ company profile. ~22 employees, based in Paducah KY, ~$1.4M estimated revenue. Presence in North America and Oceania.
